question: Does explicitly admitted, source-guarded reuse of the immediately preceding motor intent reduce measured input-free planner-wait time in the fixed real MAP01 threat fixture without hard release, scorer-isolation, terminal-score, or negative-outcome failure?
claim_scope: causal bounded-recovery mechanism under a fixed simulated 600 ms planner delay; zero model calls; not frontier-model efficacy

supersedes.reason: v3 preregistration self-hash disagreed with its audit source before the formal experiment step; v4 also adopts the subsequently retained fail-closed windowed union occupancy definition

recovery.guard: fresh typed health required; cancel on health loss, unavailable health, or non-fresh sequence

measurement.window: runtime planner-start clock to runtime planner-return clock
measurement.normal_retained_lower: union of input_ack_ns to release_call_started_ns intersected with planner window
measurement.normal_retained_upper: union of admitted_ns to release_call_returned_ns intersected with planner window
measurement.interrupted_retained: censored interval ending no later than independently verified empty-input boundary; no fabricated positive lower duration
measurement.simultaneous_keys: union once rather than sum per key
measurement.missing_completed_release: invalid measurement evidence; never zero occupancy
measurement.no_retained_input: planner-window complement of retained-input interval bounds
measurement.independent_outcome: scorer-only progress events plus final independent score, never controller-visible

descriptive_not_hard_gate.scorer_missed_sample_periods: retain per arm; missed cadence reduces event-time precision but persistent kill/death/terminal state is independently terminal-audited

decision.PASS_MECHANISM_ONLY: all hard gates and promotion gates pass
decision.HOLD: hard gates pass but continuity does not improve in all three pairs or paired median reduction is below 10 percent
decision.FAIL: any hard measurement, launch, release, scorer isolation, terminal agreement, exposure, or negative-outcome gate fails

prohibited: changing fixture, pair order, wait window, recovery pulse schedule, lease, source-age bound, guard, measurement semantics, or thresholds after viewing the result
retrying this allocation after a formal experiment step
treating missing release evidence as zero occupancy
summing simultaneous-key occupancy more than once
next_if_pass: mechanism causal block is closed; model-integrated efficacy remains a separately frozen allocation only if a model-capable execution environment and useful-effect scoring are available
next_if_hold_or_fail: retain the first valid outcome and isolate the concrete mechanism or measurement failure before any new allocation
